title: Scheme size bound for a quasi-compact locally finite type source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and assume $X$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. For a scheme $Z$, put $s(Z)=\max\{\aleph_0,|\mathcal B(Z)|,\sup_{U\in\mathcal B(Z)}|\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Z)|\}$, where $\mathcal B(Z)$ is its set of affine open subschemes and $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Z)$ is the ring of sections of its structure sheaf on $U$. Then $s(X)\leq s(S)$. The target $S$ need not be quasi-compact or quasi-separated, and $f$ need not be quasi-compact.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type; scheme size defined in section-categories-schemes preceding Tag 000I.

proof.text: Put $\kappa=s(S)$, so $\aleph_0\leq\kappa$. The affine opens $V\subseteq S$ cover $S$ by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. For every such $V=\operatorname{Spec}A$, the definition of locally finite type gives an affine open covering of $f^{-1}(V)$ by $U=\operatorname{Spec}B$ with $B$ finitely generated over $A$. Together these charts cover $X$. Quasi-compactness of $X$ selects finitely many of these very charts $U_i$, with corresponding $V_i=\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ and $U_i=\operatorname{Spec}B_i$. No quasi-compactness of the preimages or of $f$ is used. The selected family may be empty.

For each selected chart, $|A_i|\leq\kappa$ by the definition of $s(S)$. Choose finitely many $A_i$-algebra generators $b_1,\ldots,b_r$ of $B_i$. Every element of $B_i$ is the evaluation of a polynomial expression in these generators and constants from $A_i$. Encode these expressions as finite words in the alphabet consisting of $A_i$ and finitely many variable and operation symbols. This alphabet has cardinal at most $\max\{\aleph_0,|A_i|\}\leq\kappa$; [lem-weil-pbc-finite-list-cardinality] bounds its finite words by $\kappa$. Evaluation is surjective from the valid expressions, hence $|B_i|\leq\kappa$. This includes $r=0$ and the zero algebra.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type, proof. Final polynomial-cardinality estimate, with the omitted encoding written explicitly.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-affine-scheme-size] to each $U_i$. Its ring of global sections is $B_i$, so $s(U_i)=\max\{\aleph_0,|B_i|\}\leq\kappa$.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type, proof. Affine size estimate 000P.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-open-cover-scheme-size] to $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$. Since $I$ is finite and every $s(U_i)\leq\kappa$, it gives $s(X)\leq\max\{\aleph_0,|I|,\sup_i s(U_i)\}\leq\kappa=s(S)$. If $I$ is empty the same bound still applies. Neither separatedness nor quasi-separatedness is used.
